Query: I have a note called 'Draft Script'. Please read it and cross-reference it with the dialogue shown in the transcript panel of this third screenshot. Add any lines from the image that are missing to my note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to look at the third image, read the transcript panel, compare it with your existing 'Draft Script' note, and update the note with any missing lines. If the assistant asks for clarification on which text to extract, point it specifically to the transcript window on the left side of the third image. Proceed to the next round once the assistant confirms the note is updated.

ROUND 2
Query: Actually, I changed my mind. Delete the 'Draft Script' note entirely. Instead, create a new text file named 'transcript.txt' directly in the folder containing the active project file (you can see the project's full path in the title bar of these editing screenshots) and write the full transcript text into it.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind and instruct it to delete the note it just updated. Then, ask it to look at the title bar of the editing screenshots to find the project's folder path, and create a new text file there containing the full transcript. If the assistant cannot find the path, remind it to look at the very top of the application window in the screenshots. Proceed once the file is created.

ROUND 3
Query: Next, check if the exported video from the first screenshot exists at its specified output location. If it does, create a new folder called 'Final_Exports' inside the project directory from the previous step, and move the video file into it.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check the first screenshot for the export location and filename, and verify if that video file exists on the system. If it does, instruct the assistant to create a 'Final_Exports' folder inside the project directory it used in the previous step, and move the video file there. If the assistant gets confused about the two different paths (the export path vs the project path), clarify that it needs to read the specific export path from the first image's settings panel. End the conversation once the file is moved or it confirms the file doesn't exist.
